requirement.statement: The system SHALL implement AI Ctrl Workflow as a WorkCtrlFlow-backed profile adapter.

case.given: An AI Ctrl Workflow definition wraps a WorkCtrlFlow definition
case.then: The system SHALL execute through WorkCtrlFlowEngine and persist WorkCtrlFlow snapshot facts

case.given: An AI Ctrl Workflow run is waiting on a WorkCtrlFlow wait handle
case.then: The system SHALL resume through WorkCtrlFlowEngine
